Assets.NotesMarkdown:
## English

- The top of the window now shows whether Pake is activated, Create shows how many free apps are left, and Ctrl+Shift+L opens the license card.
- When the license server is busy, Pake asks you to try again later and keeps working offline for up to 7 days, instead of ending the license.

## 中文

- 窗口顶部会显示 Pake 是否已激活，创建按钮下面会写还剩几个免费应用，按 Ctrl+Shift+L 就能打开许可证。
- 许可证服务器繁忙时会提示稍后再试，这期间最多 7 天照常可用，不会再因此失去激活。

Assets.NotesMarkdown:
## English

- Pake now runs on Linux too, and one license covers Mac, Windows and Linux on up to 3 devices.
- The update card keeps its height while an update downloads, and its button now reads Install Update.

## 中文

- Pake 现在也有 Linux 版本了，同一个许可证在 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 上通用，最多 3 台设备。
- 更新提示在下载时不再忽高忽低，按钮改叫「安装更新」。
Assets.NotesHTML:
English

  • Pake now runs on Linux too, and one license covers Mac, Windows and Linux on up to 3 devices.
  • The update card keeps its height while an update downloads, and its button now reads Install Update.

中文

  • Pake 现在也有 Linux 版本了，同一个许可证在 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 上通用，最多 3 台设备。
  • 更新提示在下载时不再忽高忽低，按钮改叫「安装更新」。

## English

- Buy License now opens a one-page checkout, with your email and payment on the same screen. In Simplified Chinese it charges in yuan and shows WeChat Pay up front.
- The License card explains itself in plainer words.

- 许可证卡片上的说明改得更直白了。

Assets.NotesMarkdown:
## English

- The first address you open after starting Pake now gets its name and icon too.
- A new app icon, a mother holding her baby.
- On a slow or broken network, looking up a site's name and icon now stops within 15 seconds instead of hanging.
- From the next update on, the update notes show only in the window's language.

## 中文

- 启动 Pake 后打开的第一个网址，现在也能自动取到名称和图标。
- 换了新的应用图标，是一位抱着孩子的妈妈。
- 网络慢或者断开时，查网站名称和图标最多等 15 秒，不会再一直卡着。
- 从下次更新开始，更新说明只显示当前界面的语言。
Assets.NotesHTML:
English

  • The first address you open after starting Pake now gets its name and icon too.
  • A new app icon, a mother holding her baby.
  • On a slow or broken network, looking up a site's name and icon now stops within 15 seconds instead of hanging.
  • From the next update on, the update notes show only in the window's language.

中文

  • 启动 Pake 后打开的第一个网址，现在也能自动取到名称和图标。
  • 换了新的应用图标，是一位抱着孩子的妈妈。
  • 网络慢或者断开时，查网站名称和图标最多等 15 秒，不会再一直卡着。
  • 从下次更新开始，更新说明只显示当前界面的语言。

Assets.NotesMarkdown:
## English

- Paste any website address and Pake names the app for you, using the site's official app icon when it has one.
- Nearly a hundred popular sites, such as Slack, Gmail and Feishu, now open with tuned settings and a matching icon.
- Fixed garbled app names from some Chinese websites.
- A refreshed app icon, with clearer text and finer borders throughout.

## 中文

- 粘贴任意网址，Pake 会自动起好应用名称，网站有官方 App 时直接用它的图标。
- Slack、Gmail、飞书等近百个常用网站，打开就带好调过的设置和对应图标。
- 修复部分中文网站取到的应用名称是乱码的问题。
- 更新了应用图标，界面文字层次和描边也更清晰。
Assets.NotesHTML:
English

  • Paste any website address and Pake names the app for you, using the site's official app icon when it has one.
  • Nearly a hundred popular sites, such as Slack, Gmail and Feishu, now open with tuned settings and a matching icon.
  • Fixed garbled app names from some Chinese websites.
  • A refreshed app icon, with clearer text and finer borders throughout.

中文

  • 粘贴任意网址，Pake 会自动起好应用名称，网站有官方 App 时直接用它的图标。
  • Slack、Gmail、飞书等近百个常用网站，打开就带好调过的设置和对应图标。
  • 修复部分中文网站取到的应用名称是乱码的问题。
  • 更新了应用图标，界面文字层次和描边也更清晰。

Assets.NotesMarkdown:
## English

- Create desktop apps from a website address or the app gallery, without installing developer tools.
- Customize windows, add CSS and JavaScript, and keep multiple accounts in separate apps.
- Import and export app settings to recreate your apps on another computer.

## 中文

- 输入网址或从应用库选择网站，就能创建桌面应用，无需安装开发工具。
- 调整窗口、添加自定义样式和脚本，同一网站也能分别登录多个账号。
- 导入和导出应用设置，换电脑后可以重新创建应用。
Assets.NotesHTML:
English

  • Create desktop apps from a website address or the app gallery, without installing developer tools.
  • Customize windows, add CSS and JavaScript, and keep multiple accounts in separate apps.
  • Import and export app settings to recreate your apps on another computer.

中文

  • 输入网址或从应用库选择网站，就能创建桌面应用，无需安装开发工具。
  • 调整窗口、添加自定义样式和脚本，同一网站也能分别登录多个账号。
  • 导入和导出应用设置，换电脑后可以重新创建应用。
